statement.excerpt: None of these companies are profitable, nor do they have any path to an acquisition or IPO.

from_speaker: None of these companies are profitable
nor do they have any path to an acquisition or IPO
our_interpretation: These companies refers to Cursor, Perplexity, Cognition and Cohere.
Profitable ordinarily means positive company-level earnings after expenses, not positive gross margin or growing annualized revenue.

For profitability, use July through September 2025, the latest completed quarter that could have been reported before publication. No common public reporting schedule was established for these private companies.
For available exit paths, assess circumstances existing by December 29, 2025. The target interval accommodates the financial quarter and the contemporaneous exit-path assertion.
A path means a credible, documented route to an acquisition or IPO; it need not already be completed. A stated hope alone is insufficient.
A later acquisition does not, by itself, establish that an actionable route existed at the post date.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable evidence shows all four companies were unprofitable in the selected financial period, together with evidence of substantive barriers leaving each without a credible acquisition or IPO route at publication.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable evidence establishes profitability for at least one named company, or contemporaneous records establish a credible acquisition or IPO route for one of them.
